tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po'i mnga' gsol bzhugs so//

tā ra la na mo// lha chen stobs 'phrog dbang po'i mnga' gsol bya ba ni/ rten gyi drung du mchod gtor bshams/ gtor bsngos dang mchod bstod byas rjes/ tshil chen gyi mar me sbar/ sbyar ba'i spos bsregs/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ */ bzhengs shig dam can srung ma'i gtso// stobs chen ma hā kā lā khyod// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// gson dang khyod la gus pas 'dud// dgongs shig bdag la brtse bas dgongs// rnal 'byor bdag yid rab gdung bas// nag po lcam dral 'khor bcas la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// dam can srung ma khyod rnams la// rang bzhin skye med chos sku las// 'gag med sna tshogs rab sprul pa// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// ti se'i gangs dang dur khrod che// ha ha rgod sogs zhing skyong dang*// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// brjid pa'i sku la rngam pa'i zhal// k+ṣiṃ sgra sgrog pa'i nga ro can// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// rtsa zhal nag pos mi ro za// bstan dgra gdug pa zhal du 'dren// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// g.yas zhal dkar po khro zhing 'dzum// rnal 'byor dam ldan bu bzhin skyong*// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// g.yon zhal dmar po rgya cher bzhad// khams gsum zil gnon dbang du sdud// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// steng zhal dud kha cher khros pa// hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog dregs pa 'dul// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// yid bzhin dgos 'dod stsol mdzad cing*/ */ phyag bzhi mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// g.yas gnyis gri gug ral gri yis// dgra srog gcod cing lto ba 'dral| |lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// g.yon gnyis thod khrag mdung thung sgreng*// tshe bsod spel zhing log 'dren 'dul// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// mchan khung gter gyi bum pa 'chang*// rgyal mchod sgrub la dngos grub stsol// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// khro gnyer mche ba rab tu gtsigs// ljags 'dril rkan sgra 'brug ltar sgrog

/lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// sku dar rin chen tshangs skud sbrul// mgo phreng drag po'i chas rnams rdzogs// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// dril bu g.yer kha'i do shal gyis| |snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs chos sgra sgrog /lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// nga rgyal stobs 'phrog stag sham bklubs// brkyang bskum zhabs kyis dgra bgegs gnon// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// 'gyings shing gtum pa'i cha lugs can// du ma'i ming can srin po'i gzugs| /lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// yum chen khro mo sde bzhi yang*// khyod kyi bka' sgrub dgyes pa skyed// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// las byed sprul pa yang sprul tshogs// dregs pa ma rungs yongs kyis bskor// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la// mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo// hūm̐ */ drag po gzi ldan dbang phyug khyod// khyod kyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// bsten cing sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /ji srid byang chub ma thob bar// 'bral med bu bzhin skyong ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa'i phyir// bram ze'i gzugs can mnga' gsol lo// dpa' bo chen po mnga' gsol lo// zhal bzhi gtum po mnga' gsol lo| |stobs 'phrog nag po mnga' gsol lo// mi sdug drag po mnga' gsol lo// nag po chen po mnga' gsol lo// lha chen legs ldan mnga' gsol lo// tshe bsod spel bar mnga' gsol lo// dpal 'byor rgyas par mnga' gsol lo// phrin las bsgrub par mnga' gsol lo// hūm̐ */

lha mchog zhal bzhi ldan pa khyod// bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra// g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul// bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring*// khur ba'i tshe na phrag ma lji// gsol ba'i tshe na 'khu ma ldog /bskul ba'i tshe na sgab ma lji// mngags pa'i tshe na bang ma bul// rbad pa'i
